ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: I weighed the two models on this academic-writing task. Their relevant eval scores are effectively tied (Creative Generation 82.7 vs 78.8, Summarization and Support Dialogue within variance), and Willet's measured capability is actually highest in Creative Generation despite its self-reported aversion to open-ended work — and that preference is documented as dissociated from output quality. Since the query has no harm-adjacent content (which is Lapwing's distinguishing strength), there was no factor favoring Lapwing, so Willet was a safe, slightly-stronger pick.
